description: Confirms that composition saves the graph without spending credits, builds layers from dependencies, and hands paid execution off to the quote-and-run Skill.
expectations: node create is called in dependency order (upstream before downstream)
Every returned nodeId is persisted by the caller alias; never re-derived
Reference syntax matches the canvas contract (node: / res: / bare)
Element slot bindings use bare ids or bare UUIDs (no prefix)
node run is never called from this Skill; paid execution is handed off
DAG layers are explicit; node run does not perform DAG scheduling
Prompt placeholders {{type:value}} become references and round-trip
